_comment: Governance descriptor for Bayer's AI Pre-Flight checklist ('Create the Agent Card') and any future Agent Hub registration decision. Loosely modeled on the A2A Agent Card shape (name/description/provider/capabilities/skills), but this tool does not run a live A2A JSON-RPC endpoint or serve this file at /.well-known/agent.json — see discoverability.note below.
name: use-summary-table-extractor
description: Extracts a structured, schema-compliant Use Summary Table (28 columns) from a single pesticide product-label PDF, for EPA submission. Task-based, not process- or goal-based: one document type in, one table out, no open-ended planning or autonomous action beyond that single extraction task.

scope.inputs: One pesticide product-label PDF at a time (text layer via PDF.js, with optional Tesseract.js OCR fallback for scanned/image-only pages)
scope.outputs: 28-column schema-compliant Use Summary Table (see knowledge/schema-reference.md for the authoritative column list; app/index.html's SCHEMA constant is the source of truth), rendered on screen and downloadable as .xlsx
notInScope: No autonomous submission of results to EPA or any external system
No write access to anything beyond generating a local/downloadable file
No batch cross-label reasoning — every label is extracted independently
No action taken on the extracted data without a human explicitly exporting it

skills.name: Extract Use Summary Table from pesticide label PDF
skills.description: Given one label PDF, identifies every crop/use-site + application-method combination and fills all 28 schema columns (product identity, site, application method, rate pattern, restrictions) per knowledge/extraction-rules.md and knowledge/schema-reference.md. Cells are never left blank: NS (Not Specified) when the label is silent, NA (Not Applicable) when the column does not apply, never inferred or borrowed from another row/label.

autonomy.description: Every extracted row is reviewed by a human in the app's table view before export — there is no automatic export or downstream action. AI-proposed edits made through the in-app chat also require the user to explicitly click Apply; nothing is written to the table without that explicit action.

model.provider: Anthropic (Claude), via Bayer's internal myGenAssist (mGA) gateway
model.accessRoute: https://chat.int.bayer.com (mGA), never called directly from the browser — see functions/api/extract.js and worker/src/pipeline.js

security.authentication: Shared pilot secret header (x-ust-pilot / PILOT_GATE_SECRET) — acknowledged as a stopgap for a small pilot, not a durable auth boundary; a real Entra Agent ID managed identity is required before any broader rollout (see README.md's DSE-app route).
security.killSwitch: A KV-flag emergency stop (killswitch:enabled) checked before every AI call on both the interactive and background paths — disables extraction within seconds, no redeploy required. See README.md's 'Monitoring, audit trail & cost controls' section.
security.dailyCostBudget: Cumulative daily cap on estimated spend, default $15 (DAILY_BUDGET_USD) — a placeholder pending the shared token's real budget.
security.auditTrail: Metadata-only record (timestamp, status, duration, estimated token usage/cost — never raw label text) per call, retained 180 days by default (AUDIT_TTL_SECONDS).
security.contentSafety: Flag-only heuristic scan for prompt-injection-style phrases in label text; never blocks extraction, only flags the audit record for human review.
security.driftTracking: The independent QC agent's severity verdict and remediation-cycle count are written into the audit trail for every document (both paths); scripts/check-drift.py is run on demand to compare a recent trailing window against the prior one and flag rising High/Critical share or remediation cycles. Detection only — no automatic action; correction stays a human decision. See README.md's 'Agent drift tracking' section.

discoverability.note: This file is an internal governance descriptor only, authored to close the AI Pre-Flight checklist's 'Create the Agent Card' item ahead of any Agent Hub registration decision. The tool does not currently serve this (or any) agent-card file at a public discovery URL such as /.well-known/agent.json, and does not run a live A2A JSON-RPC or MCP endpoint — it is a browser-based app with a gated relay function, not a registry-discoverable agent service.
